reference.title: Topicmap Gesture Operations
reference.shortdesc: The read-only Operations that a secondary press on a Topicmap sign offers: Inspect Topicmap sign, Inspect represented object and Inspect relation contract. For each: its identity, its Bindings, its target, where it applies, the sector it is chosen in, and the object it returns.

section.title: Scope of this list
section.p: The list is read from the source code of dreyeck/src/topicmap-gesture.lisp and dreyeck/src/gesture-binding-witness.lisp: the Bindings workspace-action-sign-bindings of a Topic sign, association-role-bindings of the sign of a TMDM Role, and the Bindings of make-association-binding-catalog. Other systems add Operations for the Topics of their own domain through a method on workspace-action-sign-bindings; those are not listed here, and this list makes no claim about the Operations of other HyperDoc domains. A Binding comes in two kinds with one Operation: the radial menu, which a press-and-wait reveals after 500 ms, and the learned mark, a direction move made at once.

strow.stentry: Title: Inspect Topicmap sign. Data only: it names what is asked and holds no executor.
One for the menu and one for the mark, in the same sector.
The occurrence of a Topic sign: its Topic, projection and Workspace.
The native workspace action sign of a Topic and the Topic group of TALA (interactive). Not the sign of an Association.
Degrees are measured so that 0 is to the right, 180 to the left and 270 up.
The projected Topic of the occurrence
A topicmap-topic of the projection; for the Topicmap of an Item edit an item-edit-topic. It is the object that PRIMARY opens on a TALA Topic group.
The target carries no Topic sign occurrence
The Operation signals operation-not-applicable; nothing opens.
Target type :workspace-action-sign-occurrence. Omitted for an occurrence whose Topic has no represented object.
Target type :topicmap-association. Offered only for an Association that stands for a TMDM Role, one that has the property :tmdm-role.
For an Association the target carries the exact Association object under :association; an id or a label names none.
The sign of a Topic that has a represented object; the edge of a TMDM Role
The native Role edge (its hit line) and the Association edge of TALA (interactive).
The same sector on a Topic sign and on a Role edge.
On a Topic sign, the object the Topic represents; on a Role edge, the TMDM Role
For a Topic sign it is the value of topicmap-topic-object-of: a TMDM Topic or a TMDM Association. For a Role edge it is the association-role itself, not the Association, the Role type or the player.
The Topic has no represented object; the Association stands for no TMDM Role
The Operation signals operation-not-applicable and nothing opens.
An Association that has a Relation Contract
It is offered when the Association has the property :relation-contract, as the Work relations of a Work Topicmap do. A TMDM Role edge of an Item edit has none, so it never offers this Operation.
Not the sector of Inspect represented object, so that an Association that has both offers two distinct directions.
The Relation Contract Topic of the Association
The Topic that the :relation-contract property holds.
The Association refers to no Relation Contract
The Operation signals operation-not-applicable and nothing opens.

section.title: PRIMARY and SECONDARY on each surface

strow.stentry: Moves the Workspace Point to the Topic (topicmap-workspace-go-to).
Inspect Topicmap sign and, if there is a represented object, Inspect represented object.
PRIMARY moves the Point and records the Point it left in the History. SECONDARY changes neither.
Native Topicmap, edge of a TMDM Role
Nothing: no pane opens and the Point stays.
Neither changes the Point or the History.
Native Topicmap, edge of a Work relation
Nothing: the drawn edge has neither an Inspector reference nor a gesture.
Nothing: this edge takes no gesture.
Opens the projected Topic as an Inspector object.
The same two Operations as the native sign. There is no Workspace here.
There is no Workspace in this drawing, so neither click touches a Point or a History.
Opens the Association (a projected-tmdm-association for a Role) as an Inspector object.
Inspect relation contract if the Association has a Relation Contract; Inspect represented object if it stands for a TMDM Role; nothing if it has neither.

ul.li: The sectors, Binding ids and target types are the values of the three Binding catalogues named above; the tests of this documentation compare this topic with them.
The returned objects are the methods of operation-inspectable-object for the Operation and the target.

The surfaces are the renderer dreyeck/src/topicmap-inspector.lisp (the native Topicmap), dreyeck/src/topicmap-tala-inspector.lisp (TALA (interactive)) and the binder in dreyeck/src/topicmap-gesture.lisp.
